title: django-debug-toolbar 7.0.0+ Compatibility (Shadow DOM)
author: daudln
body_preview: Starting with version  [7.0.0 ](https://github.com/django-commons/django-debug-toolbar/releases/tag/7.0.0) of  django-debug-toolbar , the toolbar is rendered inside a Shadow DOM for better style and DOM isolation. Because of this encapsulation, global DOM lookup methods such as  document.getElementById("djDebug")  and document.getElementById("djdt-...")  fail to resolve and return  null.  Causing...
